title: Junior Data Analyst
description: Example Analytics Co is hiring a Junior Data Analyst. Responsibilities: build Excel dashboards and Power BI reports, run SQL queries, reconcile financial data, and support KPI reporting. Requirements: advanced Excel (PivotTables, VLOOKUP), SQL basics, data cleaning, attention to detail, 2+ years of experience with data analysis and reporting. Send your resume to careers@example-analytics.com with a cover letter.

title: Email Customer Service Representative

Requirements: proven 90%+ CSAT record, 40+ emails per day, excellent written English. Email jobs@example-support-ltd.com to apply.

title: Financial Data Analyst
description: Example Financial Group is looking for a Financial Data Analyst. You will prepare financial reports in Excel, reconcile accounts, build variance dashboards in Power BI, and support monthly close. Requirements: financial reporting experience, SQL, Excel PivotTables and VLOOKUP, data validation and reconciliation skills, attention to detail. Apply by email to talent@examplefinancialgroup.com.
